title: Analysis of Socially Unacceptable Discourse with Zero-shot Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Adopting a zero-shot learning paradigm using Natural Language Inference (NLI) to classify Socially Unacceptable Discourse (SUD) without relying on fixed annotation schemas, which are prone to subjective human biases based on demographic and cultural backgrounds.

Using GloVe-based token masking to hide words highly correlated with the target hypothesis label (e.g., masking offensive words when checking for offensive SUD). This evaluates if the model relies on spurious lexical correlations and user biases in hypothesis formulation rather than understanding the broader contextual meaning of the text.
